defs.def: the small hard part produced by a plant, from which a new plant can grow 种子；籽

ex.s: To indicate a possible danger of cloud seeding.
ex.t: 为了说明人工降雨可能存在的危险。

ex.s: The doubt about cloud seeding has disappeared.
ex.t: 对人工降雨的怀疑已经消失了。

ex.s: This gift will train a small community in India, Kenya, or Bangladesh in new agricultural methods, and it will provide seeds and simple agricultural equipment.
ex.t: 这个礼物将培训印度,肯尼亚或孟加拉国的一个小社区采用新的农业方法,它将提供种子和简单的农业设备.

ex.s: The seeds in the bag are glued to a special material that will guide them to grow in the right direction.
ex.t: 袋中的种子被粘在一种特殊材料上,引导它们向正确的方向生长.

ex.s: During my third year, I discovered that after treating thousands of seeds, I obtained just one plant I could use for experiments.
ex.t: 在我第三年，我发现处理了上千颗种子后，只得到一株可用于实验的植物。

ex.s: Airplanes seed threatening storm cells with a chemical to make small ice crystals fall as rain before they can grow into dangerous hailstones.
ex.t: 飞机向有威胁的风暴云团播撒一种化学物质，使小冰晶在长成危险的冰雹之前就以雨的形式落下。

defs.def: the beginning of a feeling or a development which continues to grow 起源；起因；萌芽；开端
one of the best players in a competition. The seeds are given a position in a list to try and make sure that they do not play each other in the early parts of the competition. 尤指网球

ex.s: Given the degree of doubt, Mr Stienwand suggests, “it would be wise to stop cloud seeding.” In practice, doubt has had the opposite effect.
ex.t: 鉴于怀疑的程度，施廷万德先生建议“停止人工增雨是明智的。”但在实践中，怀疑产生了相反的效果。

ex.s: Beautiful year-round, they invite you to enjoy the smallest detail, from the sound of grasses in the gentle wind to the sculpture of odd-looking seed heads.
ex.t: 一年四季都美丽，它们邀你欣赏最细微的细节，从微风中草叶的声音到奇特种穗的造型。

defs.def: all the people who are the children, grandchildren, etc. of one man （统称某人的）子孙，后裔，后代

ex.s: One doubter about the safety of cloud seeding is Chuck Doswell, a research scientist who just retired from the University of Oklahoma.
ex.t: 对人工降雨安全性持怀疑态度的人之一是查克·多斯韦尔，他是一名刚从俄克拉荷马大学退休的研究科学家。

defs.def: to produce flowers and seeds as well as leaves 尤指蔬菜
to become much less attractive or good because of lack of attention 变得懒散颓废（或意志消沉）；衰败
to produce other plants using its own seeds （种子）繁殖

ex.s: These letters obviously helped sow the seeds of love between the two.
ex.t: 这些信件显然有助于播下两人之间爱情的种子.

ex.s: You could try eating fish, nuts and seeds to increase your intake of Omega-3.
ex.t: 你可以尝试吃鱼,坚果和种子 来增加你的摄入量Omega-3。

ex.s: Some students get so interested in gardening that they bring home seeds to start their own vegetable gardens.
ex.t: 有些学生对园艺很感兴趣,因此他们带回家的种子开始自己的菜园.

ex.s: Part of our mission was to experiment with growing plants in the Martian soil, so I have seeds of various kinds.
ex.t: 我们的任务之一是在火星土壤中试验种植植物, 所以我有各种种子。

defs.def: to plant seeds in an area of ground 在 … 播种

ex.s: “Does cloud seeding create killer storms or reduce moisture downwind?
ex.t: “云层播种是造成致命风暴还是减少下风湿度?

ex.s: To compare different kinds of seeding methods.
ex.t: 比较不同种类的播种方法.

ex.s: No one really knows, of course, but the seeding goes on.”
ex.t: 当然,没有人真正知道,但播种仍在继续。”

defs.def: to make sb a seed in a competition 确定（某人）为种子选手
